messages:
incidents-bot: Alert: elevated HTTP 5xx and stream disconnects detected in us-west-2 streaming gateway starting ~10:12 UTC. Multiple customer tickets. Paging on-call.

aj: I'm watching the dashboards. Gateway 502/504 spike coincides with a jump in 499 client disconnects. Traces show chunked responses cut off mid-frame.

maria: Support: two enterprise customers and several smaller ones reported sessions dropping during long responses. They see partial output then immediate retry.

deploy-bot: rollout:gateway-service v2.15.1 initiated at 10:05 UTC by kim; paused at 10:11 UTC after healthcheck failures (2/5 pods reported unhealthy).

kim: The deploy adjusted connection management: reduced keepalive and tightened inbound idle thresholds. I'm rolling it back now.

jordan: Gateway logs reveal a spike in HTTP/2 RST_STREAM and GOAWAY messages in the same window. Upstream runtime logs include unexpected-eof on chunked writes.

rahul: Runtime telemetry: KV cache miss rate rose and p95 latency jumped for contexts >250k tokens around 10:09-10:14. If gateway disconnects mid-chunk, reconnects thrash the cache.

aj: Immediate mitigations: 1) stop and rollback the gateway deploy to stable. 2) enable temporary paged fallback for known affected customers and very long-lived sessions. 3) increase canary runtime cache retention to avoid churn. Assign owners.

kim: Rollback in progress to v2.14.9. Will keep older pods to avoid cold caches.

jordan: I'm adding a routing rule: if session_duration > 240s OR customer in {edu-learn, securedocs, quickchat}, route to paged endpoint. Flag = "stream_fallback_241987". Deploying now.

lisa: Sending immediate communication to impacted customers with mitigations and ETA ~25m. edu-learn is on standby for verification.

rahul: Adjusted runtime eviction thresholds on canary pods to tolerate brief reconnects. Monitoring canary cache hit-rate and latencies.

aj: Monitoring snapshot: after routing and runtime canary changes, gateway 5xx dropped from 8.2% -> 2.9% within 7 minutes. Client 499s decreased but some residuals left.

kim: Rollback completed at 10:22 UTC. All gateway pods back to v2.14.9. Halting further deploys until postmortem.

deploy-bot: rollout:gateway-service v2.14.9 complete at 10:22 UTC.

maria: Noted. Support notified customers of fallback; securedocs asked for a dedicated postmortem and timeline for a permanent fix.

jordan: Log snippets for postmortem:
```
[10:10:58] gateway: stream_id=4521 RST_STREAM code=2 peer=10.12.0.7:12000
[10:10:59] runtime: conn=9f8b error=unexpected-eof during chunked-encoding write
[10:11:00] client: 499 client closed connection during response
```

rahul: Canary metrics after tunings: cache hit-rate improved 70% -> 95%, runtime p50 latency down from 310ms -> 85ms. This should reduce the chance of backend slowdowns causing 5xx.

aj: Jordan, leave the paged fallback enabled for the three named customers and for sessions >240s for 1 hour. Then we'll evaluate.

jordan: Done. Feature flag on. ~8% of current long sessions routed to paged fallback.

lisa: Customer updates: edu-learn and quickchat confirm sessions are stable on fallback; securedocs asked for architecture review.

maria: I'll open the incident ticket, collect timeline, and assign postmortem owners (aj, rahul, kim). Need to include deploy gating and synthetic test proposals.

aj: Follow-ups: enforce canary traffic gates for connection management changes, add synthetic test that simulates idle bursts inside long streaming sessions, update rollback runbook to include customer fallback routing steps.

maria: Postmortem draft ETA: EOD today. Scheduling a follow-up review meeting tomorrow.

incidents-bot: Incident mitigated at 10:28 UTC. Severity: SEV2 -> monitoring.

aj: Closing live mitigation thread. If we detect a regression re-open. Thanks everyone for rapid response. :thumbsup:
